attestations.value: The passage notes that toponyms like Kourniachto and Kleftolimano on Phournoi are associated with pirate activity, such as hiding places or harbors of thieves.

citations.exact_excerpt:
A series of coastal toponyms documented on maps or utilized in the modern vernacular of Phournoi
are probably the living remnants of pirate activity in the past: Kourniachto (a place for hiding or lurking),
­Kleftolimano (harbor of thieves), Fygou (escape), Fylakio (guard-post), Vardia (shift or guard), Tourkolimnionas
(harbor of the Turks), Pano and Kato Maneta (upper and lower Maneta). Many of these names are commonplace along the Aegean coastline and are also encountered on other islands historically associated with piracy.
